definition: Replays cached DeepSeek planner/candidate outputs through the current verifier and composer.
Replaces the LLM extraction contract with the deterministic schema.org default contract before verification.
Removes cached LLM slot candidates and keeps only structured-source and deterministic fallback candidate producers.
Accepts only candidates that pass verifier checks directly; rejected candidates are not repaired.
Disables Step7 slot fill and conservative deterministic fallback fusion.
Keeps verifier-accepted enrichment paths in the final JSON-LD rather than applying final target-slot admission.
